title: 不管…都… — regardless
explanation: 不管 (bùguǎn) + a choice or question word, then 都/也: 'no matter …, still …'. 无论 is a more formal synonym.
syllabus_ref: 复句·条件复句：不管……，都/也……

examples.zh: 不管多累，他都坚持锻炼。
examples.pinyin: bù guǎn duō lèi ， tā dōu jiān chí duàn liàn 。
examples.en: No matter how tired, he keeps exercising.

examples.zh: 不管你去不去，我都去。
examples.pinyin: bù guǎn nǐ qù bù qù ， wǒ dōu qù 。
examples.en: Whether you go or not, I'm going.

examples.zh: 不管什么工作，他都认真做。
examples.pinyin: bù guǎn shén me gōng zuò ， tā dōu rèn zhēn zuò 。
examples.en: No matter what the job, he does it seriously.

examples.zh: 不管天气怎么样，比赛都会进行。
examples.pinyin: bù guǎn tiān qì zěn me yàng ， bǐ sài dōu huì jìn xíng 。
examples.en: Regardless of the weather, the match will go on.

title: 即使…也… — even if
explanation: 即使 (jíshǐ) … 也 … supposes an extreme case: 'even if A, still B'. The B clause keeps 也.

examples.zh: 即使下大雨，我们也要出发。
examples.pinyin: jí shǐ xià dà yǔ ， wǒ men yě yào chū fā 。
examples.en: Even if it rains hard, we'll set out.

examples.zh: 即使很困难，也不要放弃。
examples.pinyin: jí shǐ hěn kùn nan ， yě bú yào fàng qì 。
examples.en: Even if it's hard, don't give up.

examples.zh: 即使他反对，我也会去做。
examples.pinyin: jí shǐ tā fǎn duì ， wǒ yě huì qù zuò 。
examples.en: Even if he objects, I'll do it.

examples.zh: 即使再忙，也要注意身体。
examples.pinyin: jí shǐ zài máng ， yě yào zhù yì shēn tǐ 。
examples.en: Even if busy, pay attention to your health.

title: 不是…而是… — not…but rather
explanation: 不是 (búshì) … 而是 (érshì) … corrects A with B: 'it's not A, but rather B'.
syllabus_ref: 复句·并列复句：不是……，而是……

examples.zh: 这不是我的，而是他的。
examples.pinyin: zhè bù shì wǒ de ， ér shì tā de 。
examples.en: This isn't mine, but his.

examples.zh: 他不是不想来，而是没有时间。
examples.pinyin: tā bù shì bù xiǎng lái ， ér shì méi yǒu shí jiān 。
examples.en: It's not that he doesn't want to come, but that he has no time.

examples.zh: 重要的不是钱，而是健康。
examples.pinyin: zhòng yào de bù shì qián ， ér shì jiàn kāng 。
examples.en: What matters isn't money, but health.

examples.zh: 她要的不是这个，而是那个。
examples.pinyin: tā yào de bù shì zhè ge ， ér shì nà ge 。
examples.en: What she wants isn't this one, but that one.

title: 既…又… — both…and
explanation: 既 (jì) … 又 (yòu) … lists two qualities held at once: 'both A and B'. Usually both are adjectives or verbs.

examples.zh: 这个方法既方便又便宜。
examples.pinyin: zhè ge fāng fǎ jì fāng biàn yòu pián yi 。
examples.en: This method is both convenient and cheap.

examples.zh: 他既是老师，又是作家。
examples.pinyin: tā jì shì lǎo shī ， yòu shì zuò jiā 。
examples.en: He is both a teacher and a writer.

examples.zh: 这里既安静又干净。
examples.pinyin: zhè lǐ jì ān jìng yòu gān jìng 。
examples.en: Here is both quiet and clean.

examples.zh: 她既聪明又努力。
examples.pinyin: tā jì cōng míng yòu nǔ lì 。
examples.en: She is both clever and hardworking.

title: 不仅…还/而且… — not only…also
explanation: 不仅 (bùjǐn) … 还/而且 … adds a further point, like 不但 but more formal: 'not only A, also B'.
syllabus_ref: 复句·递进复句：不仅/不光……，还/而且……

examples.zh: 他不仅会开车，还会修车。
examples.pinyin: tā bù jǐn huì kāi chē ， hái huì xiū chē 。
examples.en: He can not only drive but also repair cars.

examples.zh: 运动不仅对身体好，而且让人快乐。
examples.pinyin: yùn dòng bù jǐn duì shēn tǐ hǎo ， ér qiě ràng rén kuài lè 。
examples.en: Exercise is not only good for the body but also makes people happy.

examples.zh: 这本书不仅有趣，而且有用。
examples.pinyin: zhè běn shū bù jǐn yǒu qù ， ér qiě yǒu yòng 。
examples.en: This book is not only interesting but also useful.

examples.zh: 她不仅学习好，还很热心。
examples.pinyin: tā bù jǐn xué xí hǎo ， hái hěn rè xīn 。
examples.en: She not only studies well but is also warm-hearted.

title: A 不如 B — A is not as good as B
explanation: A 不如 (bùrú) B means A is inferior to B. Add an adjective to say in what way: 今天不如昨天暖和.
syllabus_ref: 句型·比较句3：A 不如 B（+ 形容词）

examples.zh: 坐公交车不如坐地铁快。
examples.pinyin: zuò gōng jiāo chē bù rú zuò dì tiě kuài 。
examples.en: Taking the bus is not as fast as the subway.

examples.zh: 这家餐厅不如那家。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiā cān tīng bù rú nà jiā 。
examples.en: This restaurant isn't as good as that one.

examples.zh: 今天不如昨天暖和。
examples.pinyin: jīn tiān bù rú zuó tiān nuǎn huo 。
examples.en: Today isn't as warm as yesterday.

examples.zh: 说得好不如做得好。
examples.pinyin: shuō de hǎo bù rú zuò de hǎo 。
examples.en: Speaking well isn't as good as doing well.

title: 由于…因此… — due to…therefore
explanation: 由于 (yóuyú) introduces a reason (more formal than 因为); 因此 (yīncǐ) 'therefore' introduces the result.
syllabus_ref: 介词·引出原因：由于；复句·因果

examples.zh: 由于堵车，我迟到了。
examples.pinyin: yóu yú dǔ chē ， wǒ chí dào le 。
examples.en: Due to traffic, I was late.

examples.zh: 由于天气不好，航班取消了。
examples.pinyin: yóu yú tiān qì bù hǎo ， háng bān qǔ xiāo le 。
examples.en: Due to bad weather, the flight was cancelled.

examples.zh: 他很努力，因此取得了好成绩。
examples.pinyin: tā hěn nǔ lì ， yīn cǐ qǔ dé le hǎo chéng jì 。
examples.en: He worked hard, therefore he got good results.

examples.zh: 由于准备得好，面试很顺利。
examples.pinyin: yóu yú zhǔn bèi de hǎo ， miàn shì hěn shùn lì 。
examples.en: Thanks to good preparation, the interview went smoothly.

title: V 得/不了 — can / cannot (manage to)
explanation: 得了 (deliǎo) means able to do / finish; 不了 (buliǎo) means unable to. 这么多菜我吃不了 = I can't finish this much food.
syllabus_ref: 补语·可能补语2：动词 + 得/不 + 了

examples.zh: 这么多菜我吃不了。
examples.pinyin: zhè me duō cài wǒ chī bù le 。
examples.en: I can't finish this much food.

examples.zh: 今天的工作我做得了。
examples.pinyin: jīn tiān de gōng zuò wǒ zuò de le 。
examples.en: I can get today's work done.

examples.zh: 东西太重，我一个人拿不了。
examples.pinyin: dōng xi tài chóng ， wǒ yī gè rén ná bù le 。
examples.en: The things are too heavy; I can't carry them alone.

examples.zh: 放心，这点困难难不了他。
examples.pinyin: fàng xīn ， zhè diǎn kùn nan nán bù le tā 。
examples.en: Don't worry, this little difficulty can't stump him.
